title: Job: The Train Fare Desk
story: Job brief from the booking counter: tickets cost ₹20 plus ₹2 per km. Senior citizens (60 and over) get 40% off, and senior women get 50% off.
goal: Write fare(km, age, female=False) returning the ticket price as a whole number of rupees.
hints: Compute the full price first, then apply a discount only if the rule matches.
Percent off: price * (100 - off) // 100 keeps whole rupees.
socratic: Does a 45 year old woman get a discount?
Which condition comes first, age or gender?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Job: The Train Fare Desk”?
